## MKCinema 1.8: tomorrow's cinema, for the whole house

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (app 1.9.1) | Android 7 or later |
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` (the same file) | Android TV 7 or later |
| Windows | `MKCinema.exe` (app 1.3.1) | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, Microsoft Edge WebView2 |
| macOS | `MKCinema-1.1.1-mac.zip` (app 1.1.1) | macOS 11 or later, Intel and Apple silicon |
| Linux | `mkcinema_1.1_amd64.deb` or `mkcinema-1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (app 1.1) | x86-64, WebKitGTK 4.1 (2.40 or newer) |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged |

### Android and Android TV 1.9.1

- **Party cameras** in the app. Android asks once before MKCinema can use the camera.
- **Styled anime subtitles** (ASS/SSA) in the TV player, with their fonts, colours and signs.
- **Dolby Vision profile 7** files play as HDR10 on TVs without Dolby Vision.
- **Skip intro, recap and credits** in the TV player, and progress sent to Trakt, Simkl and AniList.

The update installs over 1.8.1 and keeps your sign-in. The app also offers it by itself.

### Web app 2.47 to 2.56

Every app loads the latest web app by itself. Since 1.7: a seat for everyone with its own language and stats, ticket stubs, film night, Family Helper, MK Channel, Learn mode, watch-along commentary, Your apps with Watch on buttons, watch parties with cameras, subtitles on smart glasses, sensory-friendly mode, a welcome tour that shows you around, and a new phone remote with details on your phone and Miko, the assistant. See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

The Windows exe isn't code-signed yet, so the first run shows "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The Mac app isn't notarized: open it once, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**.

**Fire TV:** in Downloader, enter `tv.mkcinema.app`.
